research.title: Image Preparation and Baselines for Surface Defect Classification
bullets: Prepared surface inspection images by checking defect labels, standardizing crop dimensions, and separating training and evaluation sets by source object.
Implemented assigned texture descriptor and linear classifier baselines, documenting preprocessing settings and reviewing confusion matrices for visually similar defect categories.

work.title: Inventory Records and Order Processing Support
bullets: Checked incoming delivery paperwork against purchase records, recorded discrepancies, and forwarded unresolved quantity or item mismatches to the responsible staff.
Organized order forms and stock records, prepared routine handover notes, and coordinated collection times with customers and dispatch staff.

projects.title: Handcrafted Feature Baselines for Scene Classification
bullets: Implemented a scene classification baseline using spatial color histograms and a support vector classifier, following the prescribed feature extraction procedure.
Compared histogram settings on a held out validation split and inspected misclassified images to identify confusion between scenes with similar color distributions.
